ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace aircraft maintenance technicians, but it will reduce routine hours. People who only follow standard work cards face pressure, while technicians who understand systems and can release aircraft become more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Diagnostics accelerate, while people remain firmly responsible for airworthiness safety and hands-on work under strict regulation.

Emphasize licenses and aircraft types and identify the aircraft you supported.

Domestic aircraft increase demand.
Technicians with release authority become more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote monitoring can watch temperatures and AI can provide early warnings, but an experienced technician still has to respond on site to unusual compressor noise, the right defrost timing, or a midnight failure alarm.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 7,100 Cooling And Freezing Equipment Operators And Tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 7,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with about 800 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $40,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace Cooling And Freezing Equipment Operators And Tenders, but they will change the role. Remote temperature control, automatic logs, and AI-based predictive maintenance are taking over gauge watching and storage inspections. Operators are shifting from recording temperatures to equipment maintenance, fault diagnosis, and emergency response. As cold-chain capacity expands, operators who understand refrigeration and repair equipment become more sought after.
ai_s2_accel: AI-based predictive maintenance that flags failures early
Wider adoption of smart cold-storage management systems
Expansion of unmanned cold storage and automated warehousing
Digital temperature traceability across the cold chain
ai_s2_auto: Remote temperature monitoring and automatic logging
Automatic anomaly alarms and text notifications
Automatically scheduled defrost cycles
Digital archiving of operating data
ai_s3_list: On-site assessment of equipment noise and condition: an experienced ear can identify when something sounds wrong.
Timing defrosting and maintenance: experience shows when frost buildup requires action.
Emergency fault response: shut down equipment, relieve pressure, and protect inventory calmly.
Deep understanding of refrigeration principles: know how pressure and temperature change.
Tolerance for cold conditions and safety awareness: enter and leave cold storage safely while preventing cold injury and slips.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. About half of logging and monitoring tasks, including temperature records, inspection check-ins, and alarms, are being digitized.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over gauge watching while maintenance judgment remains human work. Basic monitoring roles will decline, but cold-chain expansion adds equipment, increasing the value of operators who understand refrigeration and perform repairs.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study refrigeration and air conditioning or electromechanical systems. A special-operations certificate is mandatory. Train in cold-storage and cold-chain settings, practice both inspections and repairs, and learn more than gauge reading.

Learn refrigeration repair, fault diagnosis, and smart temperature-control systems. Advance from operator to refrigeration technician, earn repair credentials, and work toward equipment supervisor roles.

A refrigeration or electromechanical background is useful. Without one, start as an apprentice and earn the required certificate. On your resume, list the refrigeration systems you know, faults you have handled, and credentials you hold.

Do not hire operators solely for their ability to work shifts. Assess their understanding of refrigeration and hands-on skills. Employees willing to learn repair techniques can grow into core equipment specialists.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Link inbound and outbound inventory with temperature control

ai_s7_trends: Remote monitoring and AI-based predictive maintenance are spreading. Operators are moving from gauge watching and logging to equipment maintenance and fault diagnosis, making repair technicians more sought after.
Cold-chain logistics and cold-storage construction continue to expand. Growth in facility size and equipment volume supports stable demand for operations and maintenance roles.
Trials of unmanned cold storage and automated warehousing are shifting operators toward combined refrigeration and automation maintenance roles.

body: Cooling And Freezing Equipment Operators And Tenders operate and maintain refrigeration compressor units and cold-storage temperature-control systems. They start and stop equipment, perform scheduled inspections, record temperature and pressure, conduct defrosting, and report faults.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Remote monitoring can watch temperatures and AI can provide early warnings, but an experienced technician still has to respond on site to unusual compressor noise, the right defrost timing, or a midnight failure alarm.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 远程监控能替你看温度，AI 能提前预警，但压缩机的异响、化霜的时机、半夜那一声故障报警，还得靠老师傅到现场。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年设备操作员看护员在岗约 0.71 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.76 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.02 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代制冷冷冻设备操作工，但会改变岗位形态。远程温控、自动记录、AI 预测性维护正在接走「盯表巡库」的活，操作工从「记录温度」转向「设备维保、故障判断、应急处置」。冷链规模在扩张，懂制冷原理、会修设备的操作工反而更抢手。
ai_s2_accel: AI 预测性维护提前预警故障
智能冷库管理系统普及
无人冷库与自动化仓储扩张
冷链全程温控追溯数字化
ai_s2_auto: 温度远程监控与自动记录
异常自动报警与短信通知
化霜除霜自动定时执行
运行数据电子化归档
ai_s3_list: 设备异响与状态的现场判断：声音不对，一听就知道。
化霜与维护的时机把握：结霜到哪步处理，靠经验。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业约有一半记录与监控环节正在被数字化——温度记录、巡检打卡、报警，系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「盯表」环节，留下的是「维保判断」环节。纯值守岗会减少，但冷链扩张带来更多设备，懂制冷、会维修的操作工反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选制冷与空调、机电类专业，考特种作业证是硬门槛。实习去冷库和冷链企业，把巡检、维修都练起来，别只会看表。
把制冷维修、故障判断和智能温控系统学起来，从「操作工」升级为「制冷技师」。考取维修类证书，往设备主管方向走。
有制冷或机电基础最好，无背景可先进企业做学徒再考证。简历上多写「会哪些制冷系统、处理过什么故障、有没有证」。
招操作工别只看能不能倒班，要看制冷原理和动手能力。愿意学维修技术的员工，值得培养成设备骨干。

ai_s7_trends: 远程监控与 AI 预测性维护普及，操作工从「盯表记录」转向「设备维保与故障判断」，会维修的技师更抢手。
冷链物流与冷库建设持续扩张，冷库规模和设备量增长，操作与维保岗位需求稳定。
无人冷库与自动化仓储试点，操作工向「制冷+自动化设备」复合运维角色转变。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can make ten decent images in three minutes, but the instantly recognizable personal mark that says who made a work still grows one stroke at a time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 26,500 Fine Artists, Including Painters, Sculptors, And Illustrators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 26,200 by 2034, a net loss of about 300 jobs, with roughly 2,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $60,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace fine artists, but it will change who pays for images. AI image tools have driven generic commercial art prices to the floor and replaced much routine illustration demand. They cannot provide an original style, narrative, collector relationship, or physical experience. For artists, AI is both a more aggressive competitor and a new tool.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted composition and color exploration accelerates early creation
AI restores older work, enlarges details, and produces previews quickly
AI drafts a stylistically consistent series of works
Digital galleries and AI curation tools expand exposure
ai_s2_auto: AI image tools replace much batch illustration and generic commercial artwork
Automated creation of design assets, backgrounds, and decorative images
Early concept exploration: AI quickly generates reference options
AI-assisted writing for artwork descriptions and release copy
ai_s3_list: Personal style: recognizable brushwork and narrative create the core premium.
Original narrative: AI cannot supply the real reason an artist chose to make a work.
Collector and client relationships: trust develops through human contact.
Physical presence: original brushwork, texture, and scale shape the experience.
Aesthetic judgment: knowing what is good and why it works.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI is restructuring the production side of this career. It overwhelms batch-image workflows and puts lower-end commercial art under immediate pressure. Style and narrative in creation, plus relationships in business, remain difficult to automate. The score signals an industry reshuffle rather than occupational disappearance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is not a dead end. Artists who use AI for drafts and invest the saved time in personal style and channel development can win higher-priced original commissions. The people most likely to leave the market produce generic images without a recognizable identity.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Supporting a child's art education is reasonable, but explain the economics. Selling art alone does not sustain most artists. Students should build commercial work, personal projects, and online operations while still in school. Style matters more than grades.

Treat AI as a partner rather than an enemy. Use it for drafts and derivative assets, then spend more time refining a personal style and high-value commissions. Build stable collector and commission channels instead of relying on one platform.

Do not quit your job before switching into illustration. Build a portfolio and commercial reputation in your spare time. In the AI era, differentiated style and dependable delivery open doors. Practice pricing and client negotiation as well.
Do not hire illustrators on technique alone. Assess production efficiency in the AI era. People who use AI to work faster, preserve original identity, and handle revisions deserve higher fees.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid reference images and style exploration
Restoration of older work and detail enlargement
Recorded courses and live instruction supplement income

ai_s7_trends: AI image tools reduce generic commercial art prices, making original style and narrative scarce sources of premium value.
High-end visual demand continues to grow in game concept art, picture books, and IP collaborations.
Artists are becoming creators and business operators, with online channels and collector relationships now standard parts of the role.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 三分钟能画十张「不错」的图，但「这是谁的画」——那层一眼认出的个人印记，还得靠艺术家一笔一笔长出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年美术艺术家（画家、雕塑家与插画师）在岗约 2.65 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.62 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.22 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.06 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代美术艺术家，但会改变「谁为图买单」：AI 绘画把通用商稿的价格打到地板价，普通插画需求被大量替代；但原创风格、叙事、藏家关系和现场体验，AI 给不了。对艺术家来说，AI 更像一个「更卷的同行 + 新工具」的组合。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助构图与色彩方案探索，加速创作前期
AI 修复旧作、放大细节、快速出预览图
AI 生成风格统一的系列作品草稿
数字画廊与 AI 策展工具扩大作品曝光
ai_s2_auto: 批量插画与通用商稿被 AI 绘画大量替代
设计素材、背景图、装饰图生成自动化
初稿概念探索：AI 快速出参考方案
作品描述、发布文案的 AI 辅助写作
ai_s3_list: 个人风格：一眼认出的笔触与叙事，是作品溢价的核心。
原创叙事：作品背后「为什么画」的故事，AI 编不出来。
藏家与客户关系：信任建立在人和人的往来上。
现场感：原作笔触、质感和尺寸带来的体验。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的「产出端」正被 AI 重构：批量出图效率被 AI 碾压，中低端商稿首当其冲；但「创作端」的风格、叙事和「经营端」的关系，是 AI 很难啃的硬骨头，评分反映的是行业洗牌而非岗位消失。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 30,900 Dietetic Technicians were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 31,700 by 2034. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dietetic Technicians, but it will handle much of the repetitive calculation and recordkeeping. ai_s5_persona.建议: Study food and nutrition or nursing, then earn a public-nutrition or dietetic-technician credential early. Data literacy, clinical nutrition knowledge, and patient communication create more value than meal planning alone.

Master nutrition software and AI menu tools, then spend the saved time on follow-up and education. Progress toward registered dietitian or health-management roles for broader options and a higher earnings ceiling.
Earn a nutrition credential and begin as a dietary assistant in eldercare or a meal-service company. Résumés should quantify therapeutic-meal responsibilities and reductions in meal-service errors.

When hiring Dietetic Technicians, test attention to detail and communication. Ask candidates to restate a complex diet order. People who use nutrition software, understand hygiene standards, and manage a meal-service area are stronger hires.

医嘱异常的判断：哪条医嘱不对劲，资深技术员一眼能看出，敢开口问。
特殊状况的临场应变：病人临时改餐、家属坚持加餐，都靠人周旋。
责任心与细节：一顿饭错一个环节，可能就是一次事故。

把营养软件和 AI 菜单工具用熟，把时间花在随访和宣教上。往注册营养师或健康管理方向升级，路子更宽，薪资天花板更高。
考营养相关证书，从养老院、配餐企业的膳食助理做起。简历上写「负责过多少个病人的治疗膳食」「怎么降低配餐差错率」这类可量化成果。
招膳食技术员要考「细心 + 沟通」：给一份复杂医嘱让他复述重点。会用营养软件、懂卫生规范、能镇得住配餐间的候选人更值得留。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年信息文员在岗约 100.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 100.76 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 12.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在压缩信息文员的数量：电话转接、信息查询、预约登记都被自助终端和 AI 客服替代，纯前台岗在收缩。但「接待复杂来访、处理突发情况、代表公司形象」这些需要判断和人情味的部分，AI 替代有限——岗位从「接线员」转向「接待+行政复合」。
ai_s2_accel: 访客管理系统升级
AI 语音助手辅助查询
会议系统智能预订
客户信息知识库
ai_s2_auto: 电话自动转接与菜单
在线预约与签到系统
AI 客服解答常见咨询
访客自助登记终端
ai_s3_list: 人情接待：让访客感到被尊重。
多任务应变：电话来访一起上不慌。
沟通分寸：敏感问题答得得体。
突发处理：投诉、寻人、意外的兜底。
组织记忆：知道谁是谁、事该找谁。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明信息文员是「中高曝光」的服务岗位：标准化查询、转接、预约正被自动化和 AI 替代，纯前台岗位数量在收缩；但复杂接待和突发处理依赖人，岗位在向「行政复合」演化，单一前台职能风险高。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光提醒转型：别只当「人形接线台」，把行政事务、客户服务、活动协调做起来，从「前台」升级成「行政运营」，才能对冲岗位收缩。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 前台适合作为第一份工作练沟通和抗压，但不建议当长期目标：建议孩子把它当行政入口，边干边学人事、行政、客服业务，尽快转专员岗；形象好、嘴甜的孩子可以从服务行业起步锻炼。
主动把岗位做「厚」：兼行政、会务、客服，把办公系统和数据整理学起来，往行政专员、客服主管方向走；别满足于「接电话登记」，那是 AI 最擅长替代的部分。
性格外向、形象好、应变快的求职者可以从前台入行：优先选金融、高端服务等薪资更高的行业；面试时突出沟通案例和突发处理经验，同时明确表达「往行政运营发展」的意愿。
纯前台岗建议合并进行政服务岗：一个人兼顾前台、行政、客服，配好自助终端让员工做「兜底和升级」；给前台员工行政、客服的转岗通道，招聘吸引力会明显提升。

ai_s7_trends: 纯前台岗位持续收缩，职能并进行政体系。
自助与 AI 承担标准化服务，人做复杂接待。
前台向接待+行政+客服复合角色演化。

body: 信息文员在组织前台或服务台承担对外接待与信息服务，包括访客接待与登记、电话接听与转接、信息查询与解答、预约管理、信件收发与基础行政支持。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Tools can generate renderings, but designers still decide which parts of the story matter, how visitors should move through the space, and how to make the concept work on-site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 31,300 set and exhibit designers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 32,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 700 jobs, with approximately 2,500 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $66,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace set and exhibit designers, but it will reduce standardized roles. 3D tools and rendering speed up proposals, shifting designers from drafting to narrative planning, on-site coordination, and experience refinement. People who only apply templates face displacement, while those with narrative skill become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent solution generation
Circulation recommendations
Lighting simulation
Cost estimation
ai_s2_auto: 3D rendering
Real-time previews
Template-based drawings
Material libraries
ai_s3_list: Narrative planning: people create the story.
On-site coordination: people make it work.
Experience refinement: people judge the nuances.
Multiple stakeholder demands: people negotiate.
Aesthetic judgment: people provide the eye.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates medium-high AI exposure in design. Systems accelerate standard drawings, but people retain an essential role in narrative and implementation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is applying templates, not spatial storytelling. People who create narratives and implement them become even scarcer as productivity rises. Designers who only apply templates face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in art or design and develop narrative skills early, as pure drafting shrinks in the AI era.
Advance from producing drawings to narrative + coordination. Learn site management and pursue project leadership.
Highlight your portfolio and implementation experience, and specify the exhibitions you have supported.
Do not select candidates only for software skills; assess their narrative thinking and dependability.

ai_s7_trends: 3D tools are spreading, reducing standardized roles.
Narrative implementation creates opportunities.
Designers skilled in coordination are in greater demand.

body: Set and Exhibit Designers plan spatial narratives for exhibitions and scenes, coordinate circulation, visuals, and materials, and use design and construction coordination to turn content into experiences.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 工具能出渲染，但哪段叙事要紧、怎么走线、现场怎么落地，还是设计师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年布景与展陈设计师在岗约 3.13 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.20 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代展陈设计师，但会压缩标准岗。3D 与渲染把方案提速，设计师从「画图」挪向「叙事策划、现场协调、体验打磨」。真正被挤掉的是只套模板的，有叙事力的人更值钱。

动线推荐
灯光模拟
成本估算
ai_s2_auto: 3D 渲染
实时预览
模板出图
材质库
ai_s3_list: 叙事策划：故事靠人。
现场协调：落地靠人。
体验打磨：分寸靠人。
多方拉扯：博弈靠人。
审美判断：眼光靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的设计区——标准出图被系统加速，但叙事与落地还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「套模板」动作，不是「空间叙事」的岗位。有叙事力、能落地的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只套模板的设计师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从美术/设计起步，AI 时代纯出图在缩，早点练叙事。
从出图升级成叙事 + 协调，学现场管理，争取带项目。
突出作品和落地经验，写清跟过哪些展。
选人别只看软件，要看有没有叙事脑子和稳。

ai_s7_trends: 3D 普及，标准岗缩。
叙事落地带来机会。
会协调的设计师更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can interpret images and generate plans, but physicians still make physical-examination decisions, perform procedures, and build trust through communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 340,700 sports medicine physicians were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 349,300 by 2034, a net gain of about 8,600 jobs, with about 9,600 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2024 was ≥$239,200 (highest BLS OES bracket, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace sports medicine physicians, but it will reduce supporting tasks. AI accelerates image recognition and rehabilitation planning, shifting physicians from report writing toward physical-examination decisions, surgery, and long-term trust with athletes. Roles limited to imaging reports will face pressure, while physicians who perform surgery and communicate well will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Injury risk prediction
Training load recommendations
Postoperative recovery tracking
Reinjury alerts
ai_s2_auto: Automated image recognition
Rehabilitation plan generation
Automated medical record organization
Follow-up reminders
ai_s3_list: Physical-examination decisions: Human judgment is essential.
Surgical procedures: Human touch is essential.
Physician-patient trust: Human relationships are essential.
Competition decisions: Human experience is essential.
Rehabilitation coordination: People set the pace.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the middle range of AI exposure in healthcare. Systems accelerate imaging reports, but surgery and trust still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. What AI replaces is the task of producing imaging reports, not the job of examining injuries and performing surgery. Physicians who operate and build trust with athletes will become scarcer as productivity rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Pursue the long clinical medicine pathway and gain extensive exposure to sports and rehabilitation. Pure image interpretation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop clinical decision-making early.
Advance from reporting to physical-examination decisions, surgery, and team coverage, while building a reputation in competitions and specialty care.
Highlight specialty credentials and experience with athletic populations, specifying which sports and events you have supported.
Do not hire based only on publications. Assess surgical ability and interpersonal skill. Key physicians who can earn athletes' trust merit high compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AI image interpretation is spreading, reducing report work.
The active population is expanding, increasing demand.
Physicians who can cover teams and perform surgery are in greater demand.

body: Sports medicine physicians diagnose and treat sports-related injuries and conditions, coordinating imaging, rehabilitation, and surgery to help athletes and active people restore function and athletic ability.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能读片出方案，但查体决策、手术操作和信任沟通，还是医师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运动医学医师在岗约 34.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 34.93 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.96 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运动医学医师，但会压缩辅助动作。影像识别和康复规划被 AI 加速，医师从写报告挪向查体决策、手术、与运动员的长期信任。真正被挤掉的是只出读片报告的，会做手术能沟通的更值钱。

训练负荷建议
术后恢复跟踪

ai_s2_auto: 影像自动识别
康复方案生成

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的医疗区——读片报告被系统加速，但手术和信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是出读片报告动作，不是看伤做手术的岗位。会手术、能跟运动员建立信任的医师，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走临床医学长线，多接触运动与康复，AI 时代纯读片在缩，早点练临床决策。
从出报告升级成查体决策加手术加跟队，争取赛事和专科口碑。
突出专科资质和运动人群经验，写清跟过哪些项目。
选人别只看论文，要看会不会手术和跟人。能稳运动员信任的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: AI 读片普及，报告缩。
运动人群扩，需求增。
会跟队能手术的更抢手。

body: 运动医学医师诊治运动相关损伤与疾病，统筹影像评估、康复治疗与手术干预，帮助运动员及运动人群恢复功能与运动能力。
